approvedDeviation: Issue #630 blueprint readiness PR: the verify gate scores ~20.8k changed instrumentable lines at ~41% because the bulk of the diff is React Native cover screens (TallyHome, NotesHome, TasksHome, PeopleHome, LockerHome, Agenda* editors), shell Capture overlays, and blueprint React components (GroupManager, Dashboard, Board, ContactChannels, LockScreen, …). Those trees import native modules (expo/react-native) or large view graphs that the vitest/v8 rig cannot load as executable sources — they enter the coverage map only via the uncovered-file pass, so no unit test can mark their lines covered. Loadable paths (time-engine, vault commands/share, locker-auth, due-reminders, blueprints query handlers) are tested and were ≥80% on scoped local runs. Remove this waiver when the #630 surface is covered by component/integration tests that the coverage map can attribute, or when native UI is split behind loadable pure modules. Must not outlive the readiness merge without re-justification.
